meta.name: session-planner
meta.description: Start-of-session and end-of-session rituals. Use at the beginning or end of any game dev work session. Bridges adhd-coach energy patterns with sprint-manager tickets. Collapses the gap between sitting down and building.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用起止仪式衔接任务票证，助你进入开发状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常难以启动开发任务，需要仪式感来保持节奏。
copy.tagline_en: Bridge task tickets with start-stop rituals to get into dev flow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to start dev tasks and need rituals to stay on rhythm.

howto.what: Claude 会在工作会话开始和结束时引导你走一套简短仪式：开始时帮你查看上次留下的进度备忘、判断你的精力状态、挑选合适的任务、把目标压缩成一句话；结束时提醒你提交代码、写下进度和下一步、更新任务卡片。
howto.when: 当你说要开始或结束一次游戏开发工作，或会话开始时触发。

say.text: 开工了，先读一下我的面包屑
say.note: Claude 会查看上次留下的进度备忘。

say.text: 我现在精力一般，挑个合适的任务吧
say.note: Claude 会按精力状态匹配任务。

say.text: 收工，帮我把这次改动提交并更新面包屑
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成结束仪式。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a short start-of-session and end-of-session ritual. At the start, it helps you check the last breadcrumb, assess your energy, pick a suitable ticket, and compress your goal into one sentence. At the end, it prompts you to commit, write breadcrumbs, and update the ticket.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you are starting or ending a game dev work session, or when a session begins.

say_en.text: Let's start. Read my last breadcrumb.
say_en.note: Claude checks the previous progress note.

say_en.text: My energy is medium. Pick a fitting ticket.
say_en.note: Claude matches the ticket to your energy.

say_en.text: Wrap up. Commit my changes and write breadcrumbs.
